SELECT o.*, od.id AS od_id, od.name AS od_name, od.order_id AS od_order_id, od.dish_id AS od_dish_id, od.setmeal_id AS od_setmeal_id, od.dish_flavor AS od_dish_flavor, od.number AS od_number, od.amount AS od_amount, od.image AS od_image FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_detail od ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
AND o.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE number = #{number} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS toBeConfirmed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deliveryInProgress FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{employeeId})

SELECT DATE(o.order_time) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = #{validStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS valid_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{employeeId}) GROUP BY DATE(o.order_time) ORDER BY order_date
